This is BFDI_II's official vectorization of CatNap from the indie mascot-horror video game "Poppy Playtime Chapter 3: Deep Sleep", available for purchase on PC (via Steam) at a cost of $14.99 USD.

CatNap is one of eight members of the "Smiling Critters" group. He is a purple-furred cat with black eyes, triangular ears, a black nose and a really long tail. His paws and the insides of his ears are a darker shade of purple.

CatNap is a calming presence to the Smiling Critters. He makes sure he and his friends get the 9 hours of sleep one needs to survive.

He and DogDay are available as marketable plushies, both costing $38.00 USD, at poppyplaytime.com.

If you want to use this vector sprite for any project, you are absolutely allowed to. Just be sure to give BFDI_II credit if you ever do so.

This is BFDI_II's official vectorization of DogDay from the indie mascot-horror video game "Poppy Playtime Chapter 3: Deep Sleep", available for purchase on PC (via Steam) at a cost of $14.99 USD.

DogDay is the sunny, strong, and determined leader of the "Smiling Critters" group. He is a dog with orange fur that complements his expressive black eyes, floppy ears, and sleek black nose. His features extend to a sunshine-yellow outer mouth and belly, while a touch of Golden-Brown graces his paws, ears, and the left side of his face.

DogDay is always trusted to find the bright side in any situation, and to have a friendly word of encouragement should they feel down. He'll keep his friends up and going no matter how bad or insane the situation is.

He and CatNap are available as marketable plushies, both costing $38.00 USD, at poppyplaytime.com.

If you want to use this vector sprite for any project, you are absolutely allowed to. Just be sure to give BFDI_II credit if you ever do so.

This is BFDI_II's official vectorization of DogDay from the indie mascot-horror video game "Poppy Playtime Chapter 3: Deep Sleep", available for purchase on PC (via Steam) at a cost of $14.99 USD.


Hoppy Hopscotch is a lime green rabbit with black eyes, a black nose, and long ears. Her paws are a darker shade of green, similar to the rounded T-shape design in the inside of her ears.

Hoppy Hopscotch is a friend everyone needs to maintain their energy and enthusiasm. While sometimes impatient, she'll always hop beside her friends, even if it means slowing down once in a while to keep their pace.

Unlike DogDay and CatNap, Hoppy Hopscotch has not yet become available as a marketable plushie at poppyplaytime.com.

Bobby Bearhug is a red-furred baby bear with black eyes, a black nose, rounded ears, and padded paws. Her paws and upper-snout are pink, similar to the inside of her ears.

KickinChicken is a yellow chicken with black eyes, a half-moon shaped upper beak, and a three-feathered crown extending down the right side of his face. His feet and upper beak have an orange color.

KickinChicken can be considered as "the cool kid of the crew", and he maintains that sense of cool through anything, even in the most tense of situations. Knock him down, and he'll pick himself up, brush himself off, and ask: "What's next?".
